hook.en: Football, netball and hockey look different, but they share one idea: invade the other team's half and score. Knowing the category helps you understand the tactics.
hook.bm: Bola sepak, bola jaring dan hoki kelihatan berbeza, tetapi berkongsi satu idea: menyerang kawasan pihak lawan dan menjaringkan gol. Memahami kategori membantu memahami taktik.

bigIdeas.en: Games are grouped as invasion, net/wall, striking/fielding and target games.
bigIdeas.bm: Permainan dikelaskan sebagai serangan, jaring/dinding, memukul/memadang dan sasaran.

bigIdeas.en: Invasion games: football (11 players), hockey (11), netball (7), basketball (5).
bigIdeas.bm: Permainan serangan: bola sepak (11 pemain), hoki (11), bola jaring (7), bola keranjang (5).

bigIdeas.en: Net games: badminton (rally to 21), volleyball (6 per side), sepak takraw (3 per side).
bigIdeas.bm: Permainan jaring: badminton (mata rali 21), bola tampar (6 sepasukan), sepak takraw (3 sepasukan).

definition.en: Teams attack and defend goals in a shared area.
